repositories.extraction_or_retirement_rule: Keep separate while it owns a distinct, versioned, enforceable contract that no other repository owns. Fold into the admitted kernel canon when that contract is duplicated elsewhere, withdrawn, or no longer enforceable. Absence of a consumer is recorded and reviewed, never on its own a reason to fold.
